zh: 美股週三漲跌互見：標普 500 收 7,323.64 點、跌 16.89 點（0.23%）；道瓊收 50,198.17 點、跌 561.25 點（1.11%）；那斯達克收 24,429.89 點、漲 101.50 點（0.42%）。標普一度開高後翻黑，紐約交易所下跌家數與上漲家數比約 1.41 比 1，成交量 174.6 億股、低於 20 日均量 189.0 億股。道瓊跌幅明顯大於另外兩大指數，這是價格加權指數被少數高價股拖累的典型日子。
en: US stocks ended mixed Wednesday: the S&P 500 closed at 7,323.64, down 16.89 points (0.23%); the Dow at 50,198.17, down 561.25 (1.11%); and the Nasdaq at 24,429.89, up 101.50 (0.42%). The S&P reversed early gains, decliners beat advancers about 1.41 to 1 on the NYSE, and volume of 17.46 billion shares was below the 18.90 billion 20-day average. The Dow's much larger drop is typical of a price-weighted index dragged by a few high-priced stocks.

zh: Nvidia 週二盤後公布的財報在營收與下一季營收指引都優於預期，週三股價卻收跌約 2.9%（另有報導為 2.4%）。路透歸因於共同創辦人黃仁勳上週突然離開帶來的不確定性；CNBC 指出財務長 Colette Kress 目前擔任臨時執行長，市場在等繼任安排的清楚說法。好數字被折價，代表這檔股票現在的定價重點不在單季，而在領導層與 AI 資本支出能否延續。
en: Nvidia's results, released after Tuesday's close, beat on revenue and guided next-quarter revenue above estimates, yet the stock fell about 2.9% Wednesday (another report said 2.4%). Reuters attributed it to uncertainty after co-founder Jensen Huang's sudden departure last week; CNBC notes CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO and investors want clarity on succession. A good quarter being discounted suggests the pricing focus has moved from the quarter to leadership and the durability of AI capex.

zh: 大盤偏弱的一天，消費相關股票是亮點：TJX 因上調全年展望漲約 8%、Target 在提出偏正面的假期展望後漲約 4%、Amazon 漲 3.8%，電玩大廠 Take-Two 在《俠盜獵車手 VI》推出前漲 6.2%。路透指出消費非必需品類股是當天最強的板塊。逆風中仍有資金往零售與消費流動，是今天最值得記的一件事。
en: In a soft tape, consumer-linked stocks stood out: TJX rose about 8% after raising its annual outlook, Target gained about 4% on an upbeat holiday outlook, Amazon rose 3.8%, and Take-Two jumped 6.2% ahead of the Grand Theft Auto VI rollout. Reuters said consumer discretionary was the clear outperforming sector. Money still flowing into retail and consumer names against a weak backdrop is the key takeaway.

tag: TJX 上調但 Q4 保守
zh: TJX 週三公布 FY27 第三季：營收 159.5 億美元（年增約 5.5%，高於預期 158.4 億），同店銷售 +4%（預期約 2.9%），其中主力 Marmaxx 為 +2%、國際部門 +8%；調整後 EPS 1.34 美元，含約 5 美分關稅退款。全年同店展望由 3% 到 4% 調為 4%，調整後 EPS 調至 5.17 到 5.20 美元，但仍低於市場預期的 5.23；第四季 EPS 指引 1.42 到 1.45 美元，也低於預期 1.49。管理層把部分保守歸因於偏暖的天氣與運費、油價，股價因此是漲在「執行改善」而非獲利大幅超標。
en: TJX reported fiscal Q3 FY27 on Wednesday: revenue of $15.95 billion (up about 5.5%, vs. $15.84 billion expected), comparable sales +4% (about 2.9% expected), with Marmaxx +2% and International +8%; adjusted EPS $1.34 including roughly 5 cents of tariff refunds. The full-year comp outlook moved to 4% from 3% to 4% and adjusted EPS to $5.17 to $5.20, still below the $5.23 expected; Q4 EPS guidance of $1.42 to $1.45 also trails the $1.49 consensus. Management blamed some of the caution on warm weather plus freight and fuel costs, so the rally rests on improving execution rather than a big profit beat.

I could not retrieve its quarterly revenue and comparable sales, so only the share reaction and outlook tone are confirmed; check the company release for details. Lowe's was also slated to report that day, but its events page listed the date as tentative and I found no results. Next is Walmart on Thursday morning, whose comp growth and holiday guidance will decide whether the resilient-consumer narrative holds.

zh: 聯準會 10 月會議紀要週三公布，基調仍是對通膨風險保持警戒：官員認為若經濟照預期發展，還需要進一步升息，少數人主張如果後續通膨數據不利，應該一次升 2 碼（50 基點）。10 月會議之後公布的消費者與生產者物價都比預期熱，理事 Waller 說聯準會需要更積極，紐約聯準銀行總裁 Williams 偏向更緊的政策，但認為不需要「劇烈行動」。CME FedWatch 顯示 12 月升 1 碼（25 基點）的機率接近確定。這是「升息週期」而不是降息預期的環境，對高估值與高槓桿的小型股、區域銀行都是壓力測試。
en: The Fed's October minutes, released Wednesday, kept the focus on inflation risk: officials saw a need for further rate hikes if the economy evolves as expected, and a few argued for a 50-basis-point hike if incoming inflation data were unfavorable. CPI and PPI released after the October meeting ran hotter than expected; Governor Waller said the Fed needs to be more aggressive, while NY Fed President Williams favors tighter policy but sees no need for dramatic action. CME FedWatch shows a near-certain 25-basis-point hike in December. This is a hiking cycle rather than a cutting one, a stress test for richly valued, leveraged small caps and regional banks.

tag: Anthropic 上市看 AI 情緒
zh: Anthropic 的首次公開募股週三定價在每股 83 美元，高於原先 70 到 78 美元的區間；依路透轉述彭博的說法，它是史上規模最大的股票 IPO 之一，也是第一家上市的前沿 AI 模型公司，預計週四在那斯達克開始交易。CNBC 稱這是檢驗 AI 情緒的指標。要注意：定價偏高、散戶配售比例大（先前報導約 20%），上市首日的震盪可能大；它也讓持有其股權的 Amazon、Alphabet 成為市場觀察 AI 估值的另一個窗口。
en: Anthropic priced its IPO Wednesday at $83 per share, above the $70 to $78 range; Reuters, citing Bloomberg, called it one of the largest stock IPOs on record and the first by a major frontier AI model developer, with trading expected Thursday on the Nasdaq. CNBC calls the debut a gauge of AI sentiment. Caveats: the high pricing and a large retail allocation (about 20% in earlier reports) could mean a volatile first day, and it makes Amazon and Alphabet, which hold stakes, another window on AI valuations.

en: Babcock & Wilcox (BW, in the pool; boilers and power equipment) saw four insiders buy a combined $749,000 at an average $4.95 between 11/11 and 11/13: 10% owner BRC Group Holdings $648,000, director Tato and CEO Young about $44,000 each, director Moeller $14,000. That is a second, separate signal on top of the Q3 revenue of $291 million (up 109%) and roughly $2.5 billion backlog already logged, so it is now strong growth plus an insider cluster. Counterpoints: backlog has fallen quarter by quarter from about $2.8 billion at year-end, data-center orders reportedly slipped into 2027, and the largest buyer is a major holder rather than management. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

Reminder: small purchases in a low-priced biotech are a much weaker signal than large clusters, and trial results remain the decisive factor.

zh: 判讀卡：看政要持股要先記得申報有 45 天的時差。依 STOCK Act，議員交易後最晚 45 天內申報，所以今天看到的 PTR，買進價是一個半月前的價格，今天跟進，等於買到別人過去的成本；金額也只有寬區間，沒有精確數字。再加上許多交易是配偶或信託帳戶執行，選擇權的履約價與到期日才是真正的資訊量。因此這個頻道只能用來看「有人用真錢押注什麼主題」，不是買賣訊號。
en: Explainer: congressional trades come with a built-in delay. Under the STOCK Act members must report within 45 days, so a periodic transaction report you read today reflects prices from up to a month and a half ago, and following it means buying at someone else's old cost; amounts are also only wide ranges. Many trades are executed by spouses or trusts, and for options the strike and expiry carry the real information. So this channel only shows what theme someone is betting real money on, not a trading signal.
